checks.proves: Inventories direct balance writes, allocation/purpose bindings and ledger classification touchpoints.
checks.doesNotProve: Static search cannot prove transaction correctness or runtime isolation.
checks.passCriteria: Every value-changing path is classified and canonical writes route through WLT ledger/domain owners; allocation/purpose symbols have one authoritative definition.
checks.failCriteria: Any unexplained direct balance mutation, duplicate allocation truth or silent classification fallback fails.

checks.proves: Runs current WLT Node and Go test suites including ledger/payment/domain tests.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove live provider, browser/mobile rendering or production data migration.
checks.passCriteria: All WLT tests pass on the candidate SHA and new financial invariant tests are included.
checks.failCriteria: Any WLT test or financial invariant failure fails.

checks.proves: Exercises current WLT migration probes against supported database scenarios.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove production dataset shape or external provider behavior.
checks.passCriteria: Fresh and non-empty migration probes pass; no applied-history rewrite is required.
checks.failCriteria: Migration drift, orphaned data, non-idempotent backfill or unsafe lock behavior fails.

checks.proves: Checks WLT composed OpenAPI bundle/provenance after contract changes.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove consumers render or use the generated fields correctly.
checks.passCriteria: OpenAPI verification passes and generated bindings match canonical purpose/allocation contracts.
checks.failCriteria: Bundle drift, duplicate enums or hand-written parallel contract fails.
